Belva, as a beautiful name, may have held special significance in cultures that valued The Goddess of Beauty or Aphrodite. Belle, meaning beautiful in French, was a nickname given to the Virgin Mary, highlighting her inherent beauty and perfection. The name Belva emphasizes the spiritual beauty and virtuousness of a woman who toils and toils for her spiritual growth.
